top_signals.title: Taiwan’s Political and Security Future
top_signals.summary:
Taiwan faces mounting questions about its ability to defend itself, a bitter fight over defense spending, and uncertainty about Washington’s commitment to its security. Michael Hunzeker (George Mason University), Amanda Hsiao (RAND), and Peter Mattis (Jamestown Foundation) join Ryan to examine whether Taiwan is preparing fast enough for a possible war, what’s holding up a major U.S. arms package, and whether warmer relations between Washington and Beijing could come at Taipei’s expense. top_signals.title: ASEAN's Middle Powers Seek Bigger Role in Global Order
top_signals.summary:
Stratbase Institute Founder Victor Andres C. Manhit believes ASEAN should use its growing economic clout to help shape the global agenda rather than simply choose between the US and China. The Philippines can work with other middle powers while defending a rules-based international order and its maritime rights.
He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of the "ASEAN Summit 2026". (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Wise Group Co-Founder & CEO Kristo Kaarmann says the digital shift among Southeast Asia’s small businesses is accelerating demand for cross-border payments, with Asia Pacific its fastest-growing region.
